records.source: Hello! How may I help you?
Need a snack for the movie?
records.translation: Kailangan mo ba ng meryenda para sa pelikula?

records.source: Your guest looks hungry... I'm sure I have something they'll love!
records.translation: Mukhang gutom ang bisita mo... Tiyak na mayroon akong magugustuhan niya!

records.source: It's an upgrade from my last job...
records.translation: Mas mahusay ito kaysa sa dati kong trabaho...

records.source: Your guest looks like they could use a snack. What'll it be?
records.translation: Mukhang kailangan ng meryenda ng bisita mo. Ano ang kukunin ninyo?

records.source: You've brought this upon yourself... now I'm free... Hee hee hee!
records.translation: Ikaw ang may kagagawan nito... malaya na ako... Hihihi!
Tema ng Masayang Palabas ng Junimo

records.preserveReason: This is a stylized proper music-track title; preserving it keeps the jukebox title and named remix identity intact.

records.translation: Tema ng Ekspres ng Lungsod ng Zuzu
Kariton ng Junimo (Ang Higante ng Dagat ng Gem)
Kariton ng Junimo (Yungib ng Kumikinang na Kabute)

records.source: The camel seems to like you, sir. That is indeed a very good sign.
records.translation: Mukhang gusto ka ng kamelyo, ginoo. Talagang napakagandang palatandaan niyan.

records.source: The camel seems to like you, miss. That is indeed a very good sign.
records.translation: Mukhang gusto ka ng kamelyo, binibini. Talagang napakagandang palatandaan niyan.

records.source: Your coin has no value where I come from... Do you have anything else to trade?
records.translation: Walang halaga ang salapi mo sa pinagmulan ko... May iba ka pa bang maipagpapalit?

records.source: Welcome, traveler... interested in making a trade?
records.translation: Maligayang pagdating, manlalakbay... interesado ka bang makipagpalitan?

records.source: Adult ostriches will lay a very large egg once a week.
records.translation: Isang napakalaking itlog ang inilalabas kada linggo ng mga Ostrits na nasa hustong gulang.

records.source: Too close to a fruit tree
A human who speaks our language? I'm impressed...
records.translation: Isang taong nakapagsasalita ng aming wika? Humahanga ako...

records.source: Please, stay and rest. There are no monsters here.
records.translation: Maupo ka at magpahinga. Walang mga halimaw dito.

records.source: I haven't seen a human here for many years...
records.translation: Maraming taon na akong hindi nakakakita ng tao rito...

records.source: You are very brave to come here. Please, peruse my stock.
records.translation: Napakatapang mong pumunta rito. Tingnan mo ang aking mga paninda.

records.source: This mountain was the home of my ancestors. Now we live in the ruins of their great civilization.
records.translation: Ang bundok na ito ang tahanan ng aking mga ninuno. Ngayon ay naninirahan kami sa mga guho ng kanilang dakilang kabihasnan.
